title: Jenny S NDE 5449
content: I was sitting in the bathtub with my friend, it was raining outside. We felt as if our feet were falling asleep and a second later, there was a tingling over our entire bodies. I saw how my friend managed to get himself out of the bathtub and then I lost my breath. I went underwater and my lungs filled with water and for a short time, it was painful. But suddenly I saw myself from above laying underwater with my mouth and eyes wide open and thought, 'what a horrible sight!' The next thing I remember is that I was COMPLETE, I was at a place that was/is very familiar to me (The woods where I went walking my dog) But I understood!! What I didn't see with my eyes was becoming suddenly aware that I was no longer in this world; the water was such a beautiful blue, a swan was swimming there which seemed to be glowing from the inside out, it was radiant. Everything radiated an indescribable light and I was part of that light, everything was part of that light. It was a feeling of rest, love and serenity I had never experienced in my life - the feeling of fulfillment, of being complete, without pain, without a body. When I realized I was without a body it felt as if a block of granite had been lifted from me. I could comprehend my pure self. I was just a dot but just as lively and at the same time as softly radiant as everything around me. The grass was greener than green and smelled mildly wet but inviting. The trees and their leaves shimmered and the sound of the wind was as music. I saw the park bench and was immediately drawn to it; there was someone there. At first I saw only his/her light as I joined in the 'information room' (It seemed to be coming out of him, he KNEW what I wanted to know) I saw that it was the father of my son; it seemed as if we had never been apart. We were happy to see each other again but not ecstatically although not sad either. It was as if we saw each other again after he had gone shopping. The feeling of all the answers to my questions coming from him also seemed to be coming from a surrounding and present Power. I don't want to use a name like God or Allah because I felt a Universal love, an endless love which is present in each of us, the knowledge of everything. I was so happy there and didn't want to leave, but my ex-friend told me suddenly that I had to go back. I knew why and yet I didn't want to return. But before I could resist what HAD to happen, I was drawn away and it became ice cold and dark as soot around and in me. I was back in my body and became hysterical; I kept asking the rescue team WHY they had brought me back! When I told them I had watched how they had re-animated me and pointed to the rescuer who did it and to the one who did the heart message, I got the blunt answer that they would be injecting me with a strong tranquilizer if I didn't shut up!? This is the first time in eight years that I have dared to share this.

arrival.other_being_detail: A surrounding and present 'Power' described as universal/endless love and knowledge, explicitly not labeled as God/Allah.

environment.environment_other_detail: Familiar woods/dog-walking area; beautiful blue water with a radiant swan; grass "greener than green" with mild wet smell; shimmering trees/leaves; wind sounded like music; a park bench; everything radiated an indescribable light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She was "drawn away"; surroundings became "ice cold and dark as soot" and she was back in her body.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Described an "information room" experience of receiving answers/knowledge; transition to "ice cold and dark as soot" before returning to body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from above the body in the bathtub, then immediate arrival in a familiar outdoor setting with light/unity and encounter with the father of her son; then told she must return and was drawn back into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Arrival realm was a familiar earthly location (woods where she walked her dog) that was transformed by pervasive radiant light; described joining an "information room" where answers flowed from the father of her son and a surrounding "Power."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "But suddenly I saw myself from above laying underwater with my mouth and eyes wide open and thought, 'what a horrible sight!'"; "Everything radiated an indescribable light and I was part of that light, everything was part of that light."; "I was just a dot but just as lively and at the same time as softly radiant as everything around me."; "my ex-friend told me suddenly that I had to go back."; "it became ice cold and dark as soot around and in me."; "I kept asking the rescue team WHY they had brought me back!"
